edges.reason: msg.sender triggers the owner withdrawal path that pays the entire contract balance back to the caller.
The withdrawal recipient address is fully controlled by msg.sender and receives value via a low-level send.
Caller supplies funds and mint parameters to the public mint function.
Caller address is compared with ownerOf to authorise burning.
Owner address calling mintOwner is passed as the mint recipient.
Caller address is hashed together with block.timestamp to seed the random starting index.
_msgSender is forwarded into the untrusted receiver callback during safe transfer checks.
Mint availability depends directly on block.timestamp compared with the configured mint date.
Whitelist mint availability depends directly on block.timestamp compared with the configured date.
block.timestamp is used as entropy when computing the initial token index.
initialTokenId shifts the token index used when building the metadata URI.
cost is multiplied by the requested amount to compute the required msg.value.
maxMintAmount bounds the amount argument accepted by the public mint.
maxSupply bounds the minting loop and the resulting token counter.
tokenId is read and incremented by the internal minting loop.
The paused flag reverts the internal mint when true.
mintable() returns false whenever the contract is paused.
wMintable() returns false whenever the contract is paused.
_baseURI returns the baseURI state variable.
baseURI is concatenated into the returned metadata URI.
baseExtension is appended to the metadata URI string.
Public mint delegates the actual minting to mintInternal.
Owner mint delegates the actual minting to mintInternal.
The mint loop calls _safeMint for each token, which can hand control to a recipient contract.
_safeMint invokes _checkOnERC721Received, which performs the recipient callback.
_checkOnERC721Received executes an external onERC721Received call to an untrusted contract.
tokenURI reads the base URI through the internal _baseURI override.
withdraw() reaches the low-level send that transfers the whole balance.

The _to parameter flows into the minted token recipient.
The _mintAmount parameter flows into cost and supply checks and the mint loop.
The _newCost parameter is written into the cost state variable.
The _newBaseURI parameter is written into the baseURI state variable.
The _newMaxSupply parameter is written into the maxSupply state variable.
The _state parameter is written into the paused state variable.
The _tokenId parameter is used for the owner check and the burn call.
The finalTotenId local is embedded into the returned metadata URI.
The currentBaseURI local caches the base URI used for the metadata URI.
